events.description: Ross Geller says Marcel is coming over now, bringing the rice to Ross Geller, and giving the rice to Ross Geller.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller is thanking Marcel for bringing the rice.
Ross Geller says he sees Marcel has finally mastered the difference between the command 'bring me the' and the command 'pee in the'.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green is sorry.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green's being upset about Barry Farber and Mindy Hunter is so stupid.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green gave up Barry Farber.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green is happy for Barry Farber and Mindy Hunter.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green guesses it would feel different if Rachel Green were with somebody.
Ross Geller asks what happened to Rachel Green's vow to forget relationships and be done with men, which Ross Geller calls a 'penis embargo'.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green does not know.
Rachel Green says it is not about avoiding all men; it is about finding the right guy.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green is trying to explain her point.
Rachel Green says that with Barry Farber the relationship was safe and easy, but there was no passion.
Rachel Green says that with Paolo the relationship was nothing but intense sexual heat.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller understands Rachel Green's point.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller was present for the events Rachel Green is describing about Paolo.
Rachel Green asks Ross Geller whether a partner can be both like a best friend and sexually exciting.
Ross Geller says that often an unexpected person can be the one who makes a partner's toes curl.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller gets interrupted.
Rachel Green asks Monica Geller, Phoebe Buffay, Joey Tribbiani, and Chandler Bing how the movie was.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay is sorry the movie was not one with guns, bombs, or buses going really fast.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani does not need violence to enjoy a movie as long as there is a little nudity.
Monica Geller says there was nudity in the movie.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani meant female nudity.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani does not need to see Hugh Grant frolicking.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller and Marcel are going to take a bath now.
Chandler Bing asks whether Ross Geller and Rachel Green are still just friends.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green will see Marcel tomorrow.
Ross Geller confirms that the plan for Marcel to spend tomorrow at Aunt Rachel's place is correct.
Ross Geller says Marcel is going to spend tomorrow at Aunt Rachel's place.
Monica Geller tells everyone to hang on.
Monica Geller asks whether Monica Geller gets a say in the plan for Marcel to spend tomorrow at Rachel Green's place.
Ross Geller tells Monica Geller to relax.
Ross Geller says Monica Geller is not going to be at Rachel Green's place tomorrow when Marcel is there.
